edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom inside transfer().
transfer() immediately delegates execution to transferFrom().
The checkBots modifier runs before the transferFrom body.
checkBots executes the low-level call to protectionFromBots.
Untrusted external call in the modifier completes before allowance and balance state updates in transferFrom, enabling reentrancy.
protectionFromBots provides the callee address for the low-level call.
uniPair is ABI-encoded into the bot-protection call arguments.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is read and written in transferFrom.
msg.sender determines whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances/allowance.
balanceOf values flow into unchecked arithmetic operations.
allowance value flows into an unchecked subtraction.
msg.sender is the allowance owner recorded by approve().
approve() writes into the allowance mapping.

_value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve().
